unverified: The designated city-street list is not digitized, so plain golf carts stay red except tagged cart paths. SR A1A and SR 100 are banned for golf carts even where the posted limit is low.
sources: Flagler Beach golf cart information packet https://www.cityofflaglerbeach.com/DocumentCenter/View/6750/Golf-Cart-Info-Packet-2026

sources.label: Flagler Beach golf cart information packet

enforcement.note: Posted signs do not lift a ban. A designated street list that is not digitized stays red for plain golf carts.

cart_only_bans.names: ^(Oceanshore Boulevard|Moody Boulevard|State Road A1A|State Road 100)$|(^|;)(A1A|SR A1A|FL A1A|SR 100|FL 100)($|;)
cart_only_bans.label: Flagler Beach golf cart packet: golf carts are not permitted on SR A1A (Oceanshore Boulevard) or SR 100 (Moody Boulevard). The packet allows a crossing of SR 100 at Flagler Avenue only.
